principles: Preserve current Prompt behavior before optimizing it.
Use one canonical structured source for role lifecycle facts and derive reports from it.
Report only observable costs and label unknown layers unavailable.
Every new deterministic fact needs a version, fail-closed validator, and mutation test.
drivers: All 16 agent_prompt outputs must remain byte-identical in Story 1.
Later Stories need stable RuntimeContract, RoleContract, PromptEnvelope, and PromptMeasurementRecord shapes.
Current dispatch and verifier matrices expose useful facts but do not provide the accepted active/compatibility/retired contract.
A user-visible read-only report is needed without provider calls or Story authority.

options.name: A: additive typed contracts, canonical lifecycle registry, and read-only measurement report
pros: Keeps all Prompt bytes and runtime dispatch behavior unchanged
Creates a reusable single source for later assembly Stories
Makes observability boundaries and algorithms explicit
cons: Temporarily carries sidecar metadata alongside legacy Prompt bodies
Adds a new read-only CLI surface and verifier wiring

options.name: B: immediately rewrite Prompt templates around the new contracts
cons: Makes regressions impossible to attribute cleanly

options.name: C: add types only and keep measurement inside the existing verifier
cons: Users cannot inspect the baseline directly
No canonical sidecar/report for later A/B comparison
Lifecycle status remains hidden in test-only code

chosen: A: additive typed contracts, canonical lifecycle registry, and read-only measurement report
rationale: Option A is the only design that satisfies the accepted Story 1 boundary: it produces stable contract and measurement truth while leaving all existing assembled Prompt bytes and legal behavior untouched. It also replaces verifier-only status prose with a reusable canonical registry instead of creating another hidden audit table.

preMortem.scenario: A role status is recorded differently from current accepted authority.
preMortem.trigger: The new registry copies the old verifier-only labels without reconciling product-reviewer, legacy aliases, implementation-reviewer, or channel retirement.
preMortem.consequence: Later migration and gate filtering consume a false role matrix.
preMortem.mitigation: Freeze exact 16-role membership and explicit high-value assertions for channel/product/implementation/test aliases; mutation tests reject missing or altered rows.

preMortem.scenario: Measurement appears to reduce cost by treating unknown provider input as zero.
preMortem.trigger: Optional numeric fields default to 0 in report aggregation.
preMortem.consequence: Baseline and later A/B claims overstate commercial savings.
preMortem.mitigation: Use a discriminated reported/unavailable layer type; aggregation never synthesizes a numeric provider total when unavailable.

preMortem.scenario: Adding contracts accidentally changes current Prompt output.
preMortem.trigger: agent_prompt begins rendering RuntimeContract/RoleContract in Story 1 or template files are regenerated.
preMortem.consequence: The required 16 output hashes drift before an attributable migration Story.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep agent_prompt untouched, exclude all template/mirror paths, and run the existing proof-or-stop baseline plus before/after output hash assertions.

preMortem.scenario: Canonical digests differ by key order, line ending, path order, or locale.
preMortem.trigger: Plain JSON.stringify, locale-dependent sort, or newline normalization is used inconsistently.
preMortem.consequence: Later envelope and baseline records become non-reproducible across hosts.
preMortem.mitigation: Pin recursive key ordering, ordinal role/path ordering, raw UTF-8 byte counting, LF line-count semantics, and versioned mutation probes.

preMortem.scenario: The read-only measurement command is accidentally classified as a workflow fact or writer.
preMortem.trigger: Command catalog is added without synchronized command policy/process-fact/activity routing.
preMortem.consequence: It may write activity state, be phase-restricted, or be misused as gate evidence.
preMortem.mitigation: Register it explicitly as all-phase read-only L0 diagnostic with no evidence authority and verify process-fact contract coverage.
